description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1884/02, D/S Division, Dehiwal and Other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights and access rights for multiple parcels of land in Kohuwala. The content focuses on land property matters, including amendments to land titles, encumbrances, and servitude rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural changes mentioned, only land administration matters.
